ValidationRule.description: SS-12416 - Once a checkbox is checked, it must be locked from being unchecked. To uncheck a box, a user must submit a ticket. The uncheck action must be approved by Tim or Kareena.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(AND(ISCHANGED(Month_1_Ramp_Requirements_Met__c), Month_1_Ramp_Requirements_Met__c = FALSE), AND(ISCHANGED(Month_2_Ramp_Requirements_Met__c), Month_2_Ramp_Requirements_Met__c = FALSE), AND(ISCHANGED(Month_3_Ramp_Requirements_Met__c), Month_3_Ramp_Requirements_Met__c = FALSE)), NOT($Permission.Sales_Plan_Admin), OR($User.Id = Sales_User__r.Manager.Id, $User.Id = Sales_User__r.Area_VP__r.Id), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Ramp Requirements Met fields are locked once checked. To request an uncheck, please open a ServiceNow ticket for approval.
